name: Pūkiawe
desc: Hawaiian heather (Leptecophylla tameiameiae): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Leptecophylla tameiameiae, known as pūkiawe or maiele in the Hawaiian language, is a species of flowering plant that is native to the Hawaiian and Marquesas Islands.
